## What changes / 改动内容

Describe the learner-facing problem and resulting behavior. / 说明学习者遇到的问题和改动后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Simulator or browser behavior checked when the change affects the 3D lab / 影响 3D 实验室时，已在浏览器中验证

## Boundaries / 边界

- [ ] No generated simulator assets, ONNX policies, learning profiles, or secrets are included / 未提交生成的模拟器资源、ONNX policy、学习档案或密钥
- [ ] Simulator-only and hardware-unverified behavior is labelled clearly / 已明确标注仅限模拟器或未经真机验证的行为

## Documentation / 文档

- [ ] Learner-facing behavior and release boundaries are documented in both languages / 学习者可见行为和发布边界已更新中英文版本
- [ ] Third-party runtime or policy changes are reflected in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` / 第三方运行时或 policy 变更已写入 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
